definitions: Unilever is a British multinational consumer goods company co-headquartered in London, United Kingdom and Rotterdam, Netherlands. Its products include food, condiments, ice cream, tea, cleaning agents, beauty products, and personal care products.

PepsiCo is an American multinational food, snack, and beverage corporation headquartered in Purchase, New York, United States. It manufactures, markets, and distributes grain-based snack foods, beverages, and other products.
examples: PepsiCo is a major competitor in the beverage industry.
